family.description: This domain is found at the C-terminal region of the type VI secretion system (T6SS) immunity protein Tdi1 from Agrobacterium tumefaciens (Atu4351, [swissprot:Q7CUQ2]) and similar bacterial proteins Tdi1 is organised into a N-terminal GAD-related domain ([pfam:PF08887]) and a C-terminal domain likely to exist as an insertion in the GAD-like domain. This domain shows a two-stranded antiparallel beta-sheet and four helices. A positive groove that extends to both domains may be associated with nucleotide binding [[cite:PUB00100858]].
family.name: T6SS immunity protein Tdi1, C-terminal
